text: BREVIK, Nov. 13 — Orbiton Systems leased the Brevik ground station, according to people familiar with the matter, as the satellite operator expands its high-throughput relay network across the northern corridor. The five-year agreement, signed last week with port infrastructure owner HelioQuay, gives Orbiton access to two 18-meter antennas, upgraded fiber backhaul and a new control suite scheduled to go live in January, the people said. Orbiton plans to use the site to support polar imaging customers and maritime telemetry, with initial traffic expected to begin in March. Financial terms were not disclosed. HelioQuay declined to comment, and Orbiton did not respond to requests for comment, the people said.
